summary: Noether R120 strict-source-quality backward-lane coordination folder. It records the current resolution policy, source queue, and lower-resolution/backward-lane quality ledgers; it is not a new reader package or corrected TeX branch.
contents: WORKBOOK_R120.md records Paper 31 closure authority and the revised source-resolution policy.
SOURCE_POLICY_R120_conflicts_with_local_650_rule.md explains why 600+ ppi remains preferred while best available lower-resolution sources can stay in the active queue.
CSV ledgers record P09-P13 backward-lane source quality, IA/GDZ source searches, native-dimension probes, source queue, and manual Hathi/reference targets.
source_policy: Highest native-resolution source controls where available.
Upscaling does not create new evidence.
Lower-resolution native witnesses can be used as best-effort working evidence with explicit uncertainty notes when no better source is available.
Mathematical coherence is a secondary audit check, not permission to silently regularize notation.
limitations: Does not add promoted reader coverage, corrected cumulative TeX, or multilingual propagation.
Does not certify P09-P13/P30 or any lower-resolution tranche as critical/source-closed.
Needs compact ZIP packaging and checksum before Zenodo upload.
recommended_zenodo_action: Upload only as a small Noether workflow/source-quality coordination support package if it helps readers understand R120 source policy; otherwise keep private and fold key wording into public Noether caveats.
github_note: Corrections and source comparisons can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
